title: API Composition Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Methods for combining APIs into larger applications with defined contracts. The API Composition Database is about building bigger things from API parts: how to combine multiple APIs into one application with contracts that hold. Records include composition patterns (orchestration vs choreography), contract definitions (what each API promises), error-handling across service boundaries, data-transformation mappings, and tested composition examples. A single API is a brick; this database is the masonry.

title: API Composition Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Patterns: orchestration (central conductor calls each API), choreography (APIs react to events, no center), aggregation (fan-out, merge results), saga (sequence of local transactions with compensating actions on failure). Contracts: schema + error codes + latency SLA + rate limits per API; consumer-driven contract tests verify the provider still honors them. Reliability: retries with exponential backoff and jitter; circuit breaker (stop calling a failing API for a cooldown); idempotency keys (safe retries); timeouts on every call. Data mapping: explicit field transforms, never implicit; versioned mappings. Failure testing: inject latency/errors per API and verify the composition degrades gracefully.
